title: Book a session with Candy Heist

video.posterAlt: Candy Heist at the decks on a stage lit crimson and gold
video.title: Why one on one

intro.body: Lessons and production sessions, one on one, built around the music you want to make. Watch the intro, then choose a session below.

choose.label: Choose a session
choose.heading: What do you want to work on?
choose.sub: One on one, live, at your pace. Pick one to see everything it includes.

date.label: Date & time
date.heading: When works for you?
date.sub: Only free days can be picked. A gilt dot means there’s time open; times are in Halifax time.
date.pickDay: Pick a day to see its open times.

details.label: Your details
details.heading: Tell us a little about you
details.sub: Your name, your email and where you’d like to meet. The rest helps Candy prepare.
details.subDiscord: Your name, your email and your Discord, so Candy can add you. The rest helps him prepare.

meetOn.label: Meet on
meetOn.helpMeet: The Google Meet link comes in your confirmation email.
meetOn.helpDiscord: Candy will add you on Discord. A Google Meet link comes in your email too, just in case.

note.label: A note for Candy Heist
note.placeholder: Your goals, your setup, a reference track…

errors.name: Add your name.
errors.email: Add an email address we can reach you at.
errors.emailInvalid: That email address doesn’t look right.
errors.instagram: That Instagram handle doesn’t look right.
errors.discord: That Discord username doesn’t look right.
errors.discordRequired: Add your Discord username, so Candy can add you.
errors.phone: That phone number doesn’t look right.

payment.label: Payment
payment.heading: Lock in your session
payment.sub: An advance payment secures the time. The confirmation email follows straight after.
payment.secure: Handled securely by Stripe. Your card details never touch this site.

notes.title: Confirmed by email
notes.text: Details and the call link, right after paying.

confirmation.heading: You’re booked.
confirmation.body: We’ve sent the call link to {email}. Stay tuned, and get everything ready for the day.
confirmation.bodyDiscord: Candy will add you on Discord before the day. Your email has a Google Meet link too, just in case.

email.subject: You’re booked.
email.body: {date}, {time} Halifax time, on Google Meet. Send anything you want to go through before the day.
email.bodyDiscord: {date}, {time} Halifax time. Candy will add you on Discord and message you before the day. If anything goes wrong there, join on Google Meet instead.
